name: fl-court-docs
description: Draft and format pleadings, motions, and orders for Florida trial courts. Applies Fla. R. Civ. P. 1.100 / 1.080 statewide formatting; covers Miami-Dade Circuit Court (11th Judicial Circuit), Broward Circuit Court (17th JD), Orange County Circuit Court (9th JD) plus a county-courts roll-up for the remaining 64 counties; a dedicated fl-small-claims skill for the county court small-claims track (Fla. R. Sm. Cl. Ct.); and fl-family-court for the Family Division. Florida-specific: no-fault divorce (dissolution) under Fla. Stat. § 61.052; equitable distribution (not community property); PACE mandatory e-filing; county court $50,000 civil cap; 5-year SOL for written contracts (§ 95.11(2)(b)); 4-year SOL for negligence (§ 95.11(3)(a)); Florida Consumer Collection Practices Act (FCCPA, § 559.72). Subject-matter bundles: fl-consumer-debt (FDCPA, FCCPA, chain of title), fl-family-law (dissolution, custody, child support, equitable distribution), fl-landlord-tenant (FRLA, § 83 notices and remedies), fl-personal-injury (pure comparative fault § 768.81, sovereign immunity § 768.28), fl-employment (FCRA § 760, wage-and-hour, workers' comp), fl-commercial-disputes (UCC, FDUTPA § 501.204).
